issues.claim: sets the GC heap hard limit to the larger of 20 MB and 75% of that limit
issues.problem: The docs excerpt says the setting applies only to 64-bit processes. It also defines the limit as the maximum commit size for the GC heap and GC bookkeeping, not only the managed heap. Neither point is mentioned, though neither changes the answer.
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally add a short note in both locales: the setting applies to 64-bit processes only, and the limit covers the GC heap together with GC bookkeeping.
